July 19, 1973
Mr. Richard A. Traussi, Acting Director Community Development Disaster Recovery Office Lackawanna County Building Spruce and Adams Avenue Scranton, Pa. 18503
Dear Mr. Traussi
Re: Draft Environmental Statement
Penn Susquehanna Urban Renewal Project
Harrisburg, Pennsylvania HUD Project No. PA-R-634C
I have read the "Draft Environmental Statement". My comments will follow the review outline suggested by Mr. Gorham L. Black, Jr., Regional Coordinator, HUD.
1. Planning priorities
The Penn-Susquehanna Urban Renewal Project satisfies many of the planning priorities of Uptown Harrisburg.
When completed it will have reversed the trend of commercial replacing residential characteristic.
2. Current need
The net effect anticipated is a more stable, less mobile, and more evenly dispersed population.
3. Consultation  No
4. Duplication  No
5. Adverse effects  Some expected discomfort due to dislocation and move out of less than 100 families.
6. How to improve  Do not know
7. Coordination  Do not know
8. Funded by agency  No
9. Similar activity  No
10. Capability of applicant  Has good performance history.
